slots.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

slots.title: Bitcoin developer proposes ‘landmines’ to make quantum thieves lose their own BTC
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Anyone trying to move vulnerable bitcoin would have to put up matching collateral, giving prepared owners a chance to take both.
